news.bodyKey:
Glam Rock TD is officially out on Google Play!

Thank you for being here on day one. What started as a small idea is now a full show: story levels to beat, towers to unlock and upgrade, an Endless mode to push as far as you can, and a Bestiary full of enemies to discover.

Create your profile to keep your progress and your collection safe, then turn up the volume and let the show begin.

This is only the first act: more content and improvements are already on the way. Thank you for your support!
